research.reference: 238 eye rays; near 1000cm/100ms, far after near miss every 500ms; NAVSTAT1 2838834 triangles in cm; acceptance uses exact endpoint replay and synthetic box 0.001cm
research.pitfalls: Embree argument filters must be enabled on scene/geometry; Warp mesh_query_ray has no native backface filter; static dump lacks body/subshape and interactive metadata
research.engine_support: Vendored Jolt 5.6.0 provides no-lock queries and native CharacterVirtual; PhysicsSystem::Update rebuilds dirty broadphase trees without an explicit OptimizeBroadPhase call

limitations: NAVSTAT1 has no source body IDs: Jolt uses one static mesh body per category. OptimizeBroadPhase on four bodies cannot reproduce the engine's 6993-body insertion tree.
Static snapshot excludes NPCs and movable props; category 4 is frozen in its dumped kinematic pose.
Dumped Jolt triangles are quantized; source-plane refinement, edge retry and source duplicate/material metadata are absent.

CharacterVirtual excludes engine contact listeners, interactive furniture stair veto, NPC clipping, moving supports and world stepping. Measures native static collision cost, not the full MoveAlgo wrapper.
Numerical attribution of replay/runner eye gap needs the original body boundaries/insertion layout, absent from NAVSTAT1.
Twenty static mismatch examples are recorded, but exact engine source-face/edge causes cannot all be isolated without source metadata.
Only embree1-cull and 1000-character scaling were rerun with per-point load; other original points retain the initial phase-load snapshot.
embree_backfaces: RTCIntersectArguments.filter + RTC_SCENE_FLAG_FILTER_FUNCTION_IN_ARGUMENTS; reject dot(direction, Ng) >= 0; geometry argument-filter enabled; two-sided queries omit filter. Incoherent traversal.

character_scaling.scene_layout: One PhysicsSystem per worker, identical static BodyIDs, shared immutable MeshShape pointers (asserted); no world stepping
character_scaling.copy_memory: Delta of glibc mallinfo2 uordblks+hblkhd around scene copies, before characters/worker allocators; excludes shared meshes and allocator arenas
character_scaling.cause: CharacterVirtual::Update applies ground weight via locking BodyInterface::AddImpulse even for static ground. AddImpulse takes BodyLockWrite before IsDynamic, serializing characters on the shared landscape. CharacterVirtual also hardwires locking narrowphase/body interfaces; its API has no NoLock injection. Private PhysicsSystems remove shared body/broadphase locks. The zero-mass control skips only the ground-weight call, preserving these static trajectories.
